Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Swati Saxena. I am a 32-year-old railway employee living in Kolhapur. Ravi Gowda gave me a cheque for ₹5,80,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 81360 56461 or email swati.saxena41@example.in.
